purpose: AI-generated 2:1 coastal environment panorama for Runway Glide's distant 3D background and reflections.

generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: realistic 3D flight-simulator environment panorama, distant background and reflection texture.
Primary request: generate a NEW very wide 2:1 equirectangular-style 360-degree coastal environment panorama, at the highest practical resolution (ideally 4096 x 2048). This is an environment texture, not a perspective camera view or a scene illustration.
Scene/backdrop: Mediterranean-style coastal atmosphere with deep blue and teal sea below, distant layered rocky coastal mountains and low natural headlands distributed around a perfectly level horizon. No nearby land or foreground objects. Soft distance haze produces convincing depth in mountain layers. The upper half is mostly clear rich blue sky with a few natural soft cumulus clouds; the lower half is mostly deep blue sea with subtle gentle wave detail and distant land at the horizon.
Projection/composition: a rectangular 2:1 latitude-longitude environment map intended to wrap inside a 3D sky sphere. Place the sea horizon exactly on the horizontal midline and maintain it level across the full width. Distant mountains may rise slightly above the midline but leave the vast majority of the upper half open sky. The left and right image edges must meet naturally when wrapped horizontally, with matching sky, cloud, horizon, and ocean color at the seam. Continuous panoramic composition, no central vanishing point, no perspective foreground, no lens border, no fisheye circle. The zenith at the top edge should be mostly quiet blue and the nadir at the bottom edge quiet ocean, with minimal distinctive features at those edges.
Lighting/mood: warm late-afternoon sunlight from the upper-left quadrant, warm golden edges on sparse soft clouds and mountain ridges, natural sea reflections, luminous but restrained atmosphere. Rich azure upper sky, blue-gray layered mountain distance, sapphire and teal ocean, subtle peach and warm gold light; realistic high-end flight-simulation promotional quality with crisp natural textures and physically plausible daylight.
Constraints: environment only. No aircraft, runway, airport, buildings, houses, roads, boats, vehicles, people, trees close to camera, foreground rocks or cliffs, islands close to camera, text, UI, logos, watermarks, borders, collage panels, or visible sphere. Preserve a coherent level 360-degree horizon and a wide 2:1 aspect ratio.

review: Visually inspected: 2:1 wide panorama with mostly open blue sky, soft golden clouds, warm sunlight at left, distant layered coastal mountains along a level near-midline horizon, and deep blue sea below. No aircraft, runway, buildings, UI, text, or logos.
limitations: Standard dynamic-range PNG generated in an equirectangular-style composition. A mathematically seamless horizontal join and physically calibrated HDR lighting are not guaranteed.
